translations.text: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, to the peoples who are called, loved by God the Father and kept in Jesus Christ.
May mercy, peace, and love increase for you.

My dear friends, while making every effort to write to you about the life we share, I found it necessary to write and urge you to struggle for the faith that was handed down to the holy ones once for all.

For certain people have gained entry, people whose condemnation was written about beforehand from the beginning. They are wicked people who turn the grace of our God into indecency and deny God, the only Master, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
Now I want to remind you, although you know all these things, that after God had once saved the people from Egypt, he subsequently destroyed those who did not believe.
And the angels who did not keep their position of authority but abandoned their own dwelling he keeps beneath deep darkness, in unknown bonds, for the judgment of the great day.

Likewise, Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding cities, which committed sexual immorality in the same way as these and pursued other flesh, are set out as an example of eternal fire, condemned to punishment.
In the same way, these people, driven by desires in their dreams, defile the flesh, reject authority, and speak abusively of glory.
But Michael the archangel, when he was disputing with the devil about the body of Moses, did not dare to bring an abusive judgment against him. Instead, he said, “May the Lord rebuke you.”
But these people speak abusively about what they do not know, and they are destroyed by the things they understand instinctively, like unreasoning animals.
Woe to them! They have followed the way of Cain, rushed after Balaam’s error for payment, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.

These are the people who revel in their feasts while defiling themselves, feeding themselves without fear. They are clouds without rain, driven about by winds; trees whose fruit has failed, bearing no fruit, twice dead and uprooted.
They are fierce waves of the sea, displaying their shame through their foam; misleading stars, for whom the gloom of darkness is reserved forever.
Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied about these people, saying, “Look, the Lord is coming with tens of thousands of holy ones
to pass judgment on everyone and to convict every soul concerning all the deeds they have wickedly committed and all the harsh words that wicked sinners have spoken.”
These are people who grumble and find fault with everything, following their own desires. Their mouths speak arrogant things, and they flatter people for personal gain.
But you, my dear friends, remember the words spoken beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
They used to tell you that in the last days there would be mockers who follow wickedness according to their own desires.
These are the ones who cause divisions, worldly people who do not have the Spirit.
But you, my beloved, build yourselves up anew in your holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
Let us keep ourselves in the love of God as we wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ, which brings us eternal life.
Snatch some of them out of the fire.
And when they repent, have mercy on them with fear, hating even the garment stained by the flesh.
Now to him who is able to keep us from stumbling and from stain, and to make us stand without blemish:
God alone, our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, before his glory with joy—to him be glory, dominion, honor, and majesty, both now and through all ages. Amen.
